en.headline: Staff find pried-open rear door at To Kwa Wan restaurant, losses still being counted
en.dek: Police are treating a report of a broken rear door and signs of searching inside a ground-floor eatery on Ma Hang Chung Road as a burglary.
body: Staff at a restaurant on the ground floor of Po Kwong Building at 2C Ma Hang Chung Road in To Kwa Wan discovered on Tuesday morning that the rear door had been pried open.
Police were called at about 11:53am and found signs that the premises had been searched. Officers have classified the case as a burglary and are investigating.
The amount of any losses has not yet been determined as staff continue to check the premises.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣食肆後門被撬開 職員發現搜掠痕迹列爆竊案
zh.dek: 土瓜灣馬坑涌道寶光大廈地下一間食肆職員周二上午發現後門被撬毀，店內有搜掠痕迹，警方列作爆竊案調查，損失有待點算。
body: 土瓜灣馬坑涌道2C號寶光大廈地下一間食肆的職員，周二上午約十一時五十三分發現後門被撬開，店內有搜掠痕迹。
警方接報到場調查，將案件列作爆竊案處理，正追查涉案人士。
食肆職員仍在點算損失，暫時未能確定失物數量及價值。
